title: Hold works on pads, and 29 lessons
thisBuild: Hold now latches pads on the grid, not just keys. Turn on H, tap a pad: it keeps playing, with an H in its corner. Tap it again to let it go. It keeps as many as the number under H, like keys do.

Learn (in the ☰ menu) now has 29 lessons. New: Dock filter, Lock, Chords and key, XY setup, My Desk, Record live, Song, Bottle it, Record onto a pad, The Sample sheet, Granular from your sounds, Acid slides, Favorites.
The Hold and On the beat lessons are back on the pad grid.
watch: Hold on, tap two pads, switch to bank 2 and back: both should still be playing, and tapping each lets it go.
Run a few of the new lessons. Send a note wherever a step doesn't move on or the yellow box points at the wrong thing.
The Favorites lesson stars a real sound (stars aren't part of the practice mess): unstar it from the pad menu if you don't want it.
limits: The Sample sheet lesson can't see which tab is open, so its Tools step waits for you to tap Skip step.
Steps in menus (pad menu, ☰) ring the pad or button that opens the menu, not the item inside it.
Lessons know you did a step, not how it sounded.
